finding: A policy of induction of labor at ≥ 41 weeks gestation reduced the rate of cesarean delivery without any adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes compared to a policy of induction at ≥ 42 weeks gestation.
mod_finding: This study found that a policy of inducing labor at ≥ 41 weeks gestation, compared to ≥ 42 weeks, reduced the rate of cesarean delivery without negatively impacting maternal or neonatal outcomes.
